What I fixed and polished (checked in Chrome on a 1440px desktop and at 390px phone size with touch, in light and dark, with no console errors; nothing in /Users/romello/code/gps-website was touched):
- **Phone layout was broken.** The canvas wasn't clipped, so on mobile the page grew to about 1468px wide, the mode bar went off-screen and you got scrollbars. The canvas is now clipped to the screen.
- **Pinch on touch screens didn't work.** There was no two-finger handling. I added pinch-to-zoom for touch and for Safari's trackpad pinch. Zooming now stays anchored on the point under your fingers or cursor.
- **Shades looked all the same.** The random function was biased, so nearly every shade landed in the bottom half. I replaced it with an evenly spread one. Shades now come from theme colours instead of opacity, so they hold up in dark mode and where squares sit close together.
- **Clicks counted outside the squares.** Clicking the empty space around a square used to count as clicking it. Now only the square itself opens (it gets a highlight ring and a short "Open in Focus → #seed" message), and a drag never counts as a click.
- **C's squares overlapped and the page was sparse.** I rebuilt the layout as described above.
- **Added** a small zoom control (− / % / +, where the % resets the zoom; on phones it's just the % at top-right), keyboard controls (arrow keys, + / −, 0, Esc), a pop-in for new squares, and a blank favicon that stops a file:// console error.
- **The hint** is now a readable pill that fades after your first pan or zoom, with shorter wording on phones.

The mode bar is unchanged and the pages don't draw a title, description or theme switch. Everything is inline, with no outside requests. It only writes canvas-*.html; gen.py was not run or edited.

table-a.html | A · Spreadsheet | A classic sortable table with a thumbnail, seed, size, shade (with a small bar), score dots and created date. Click a column header to sort and click it again to reverse; the row you click stays highlighted and shows "Open →".
table-b.html | B · Cards | A grid of cards, each with a large preview and its properties listed underneath. Sort chips sit above the grid, and the property you sorted by is shown in bold on every card.
table-c.html | C · Split preview | A sortable list on the left and a large preview with the full properties of the hovered row on the right; ↑/↓ move through the rows and Enter opens one. On a phone the preview sits above the list: the first tap shows a row in the preview and a second tap opens it.
table-d.html | D · Grouped | A new option: outputs grouped by day, score or size bucket, with collapsible headers showing the count, a strip of tiny thumbnails and the average score. Each output is a compact row with its key properties on one line.

What I fixed (I only edited table-*.html; gen.py was not run or changed):
- **Bug in gen.py's shared `hash()` (affects canvas and focus too):** it only ever returns values below 0.5. So scores only went from 1 to 3, sizes were squeezed into the bottom half of their range, and dates fell between Oct 1 and Oct 6. I swapped in a fully mixing hash in the table pages only, with a comment. The seeds in the table pages therefore no longer match canvas/focus. The owner of gen.py should apply the same fix so all pages share data again.
- **Click to open:** none of the drafts had it before. All four now show a "Opening #seed in Focus →" toast, mark the clicked output as selected, and support Enter/Space from the keyboard.
- **Rows hidden by the bar:** the scroll areas used to stop 70px above the bottom, leaving a dead strip. Content now scrolls under the bar with 104px of bottom padding. I checked that the last row ends about 42px above the bar in every page, on desktop and at 390px.
- **A:** sorting was there but showed no arrow or direction. Headers are now buttons with ▲/▼ arrows, each column has a sensible default direction, and ties break by seed. I fixed the sticky header offset and added ↑/↓ row navigation. At 390px the date stacks over a muted time, so the table fits with no sideways scroll.
- **B:** the dropdown only sorted descending. It is now a row of sort chips with reversible direction (it scrolls sideways on a phone). Dates no longer wrap inside cards, and phones get two columns.
- **C:** it had no sorting. Clicking, Enter and the "Open in Focus" button did nothing, even though the hint promised Enter. The page re-rendered the whole table on every hover, and on a phone it hid the preview completely. All of that is fixed. The hint that used to overlap the rows now sits inside the preview panel. Arrow keys also threw a `closest is not a function` error when the event target was the document; that is fixed too.
- **Checks:** no console errors on any page, and no page scrolls sideways at 390px. Light and dark both look right (checked with the system setting and with `data-theme`). The pages make no external requests and have no title or theme switch of their own. The mode bar is unchanged.

The whole UI is one rounded pill floating at the top centre. Canvas | Table sits on the left, and to its right the pill grows or shrinks to fit the current mode's controls. When you open a square, the mode switch shrinks into a "← Canvas" (or "← Table") back button, and the rest of the pill turns into a trail of small thumbnails ending in the current seed, plus a Focus layout picker.

What's in each mode:
- **Canvas:** Staggered | Contact sheet, plus a zoom readout (e.g. "135%") that resets the view when clicked. Drag pans and the scroll wheel zooms.
- **Table:** a layout dropdown (icon and name) and a sort dropdown such as "Score ↓"; picking the same sort key again flips the direction.
- **Table, Grouped layout:** the sort control is swapped for a "by Day" group-by dropdown, and a "⋯" menu holds Collapse all / Expand all.
- **Focus:** you get the trail of earlier squares (click one to jump back to it) and a layout dropdown for Strip / Compass / Inspector / Dials, which keys 1–4 also switch. Back or Esc returns to the mode you came from.

Notable points:
